scenicChapters.title: Slovak High Tatras Freedom Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 40 km this is Slovak High Tatras Freedom Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-l-arc-abric-de-la-tenalla.story: From Albocàsser it runs 162 km to Albocàsser; allow about 2 h 48 of riding. It goes by way of Abric del mas dels Ous, Galeria del Roure, Abric de la Tenalla and back through Galeria del Roure. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.
